LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_CavesWithLake.des: An underground lake connected to a river. Before taking the detour, some nearby resources can be gathered, though nothing particularly noteworthy?
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_FairyRing.label: Mushroom Circle
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_FairyRing.descrip: The driller has unearthed a mushroom circle. Hurry and gather these precious wild fungi!
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Flesh.label: Fleshbeasts Cavern
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Flesh.description: The driller has reached the lair of the Fleshbeasts. Note: Killing the Dreadmeld will cause the cavern to collapse.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_GuerrillaBase.des: The driller excavated near a Ratkin Underground Partisan base.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Lode.label: Underground Mineral Vein
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Lode.description: The driller excavated near an underground mineral vein. You can get out of the vehicle to dig minerals.
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Worm.label: Insectoids Worm
LanguageData.RKU_MapParent_BuildMap_Worm.description: The driller excavated near an Insectoids worm.
